question: Should pending Skill Workshop approvals be permanently bound to the proposal version that the operator reviewed, requiring a fresh review after any revision?
rationale: The patch deliberately changes the behavior of existing pending approval prompts to prevent approval of newer, unreviewed proposal content; code review cannot decide whether that operator-facing compatibility tradeoff is the intended long-term product contract.

options.title: Adopt version-bound pending approvals
options.body: Accept the fail-closed contract so a revised proposal always requires a fresh operator review and approval.

options.title: Keep existing pending-approval behavior
options.body: Land or redesign the preview without requiring proposal-version matching for already-created pending approval prompts.

recommendation.title: Adopt version-bound pending approvals
recommendation.body: Accept the fail-closed contract so a revised proposal always requires a fresh operator review and approval.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining blocker is product acceptance of the operator approval contract, and this account was explicitly brought into the PR triage discussion.
